instagram.caption:
The half bottles.
The Garden and Plant Care Zone in the Patio or Deck. Keep the containers alive and keep everything that feeds them off the ground and out of reach.

What done looks like:
1. Every saucer empty
2. Pots nested by size along the wall with drain holes clear
3. One tool caddy holding trowel
4. A latched chemical box above the tools with no more in it than you can name from the doorway

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success garden and plant care zone.
